transformations.rationale: Adapted the inherent `&mut self` receiver to the explicit harness receiver `slice: &mut [T]`; no target semantics were changed.
Represented Rust 1.96 `get_disjoint_check_valid(&indices, self.len())?` as a named private-helper boundary that supplies exactly the Ok/Err disjoint-validity split used by the generated contract.
Preserved the success path as `unsafe { Ok(get_disjoint_unchecked_mut(indices)) }` and reused the verified unchecked-disjoint target boundary for the raw pointer/MaybeUninit/indexing internals.
